name: kz-pgw-mcp
description: Staging backoffice API + read-only staging Postgres for KZ payment gateway work.
long_description:
One MCP server for PGW investigation on staging.

- `bo_*` tools: login (with TOTP), find test members, create deposit/withdraw orders, raw API calls against https://api.<group>.trykz.dev
- `pg_*` tools: read-only SQL, list databases/tables, describe tables on the staging cluster (kz-tpg1, kz-tco, ...)

Writes (deposit/withdraw/non-GET API) are off unless you enable them below.

tools.name: bo_login
tools.description: Login to a staging group backoffice (step 1)

tools.name: bo_check_access
tools.description: Can this staff login create deposits / withdraws on the group? (DB read)

tools.name: bo_find_member
tools.description: Find test members by wallet balance (DB read)

tools.name: bo_create_deposit
tools.description: Create a deposit order (needs writes enabled)

tools.name: bo_create_withdraw
tools.description: Create a withdraw order (needs writes enabled)

tools.name: pg_list_databases
tools.description: List databases on the staging cluster

tools.name: pg_describe_table
tools.description: Columns, indexes, FKs of a table

kz_username.title: Backoffice username
kz_username.description: Staff login. Same for all staging groups.

kz_password.title: Backoffice password
kz_password.description: Staff password for the staging backoffice.

allow_writes.title: Enable write tools
allow_writes.description: bo_create_deposit, bo_create_withdraw and non-GET bo_api. Creates real fundingTx on staging.

ssh_host.title: SSH jump host
ssh_host.description: pgAdmin → SSH Tunnel tab. Leave empty for direct connect.

ssh_port.title: SSH port
ssh_port.description: SSH port of the jump host. Default 22.

ssh_user.title: SSH user
ssh_user.description: SSH username on the jump host.

ssh_password.title: SSH password
ssh_password.description: Leave empty to use ~/.ssh keys / ssh-agent instead.

vpn_gateway.title: NordLayer gateway
vpn_gateway.description: Named in the error message when the DB is unreachable.

skills_dir.title: Claude skills folder
skills_dir.description: Where bundled skills (kz-bo-pgw, kz-sql, kz-pgw-issue) are copied. Leave empty for ~/.claude/skills. Type off to skip.
